summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new /api/campaigns feature. 14 pytest cases green (list/filter/detail/apply + role guards + duplicate 409 + admin-can-see-draft/closed). Frontend Playwright flow green: unauthenticated /campaigns → /login; brand → /dashboard and no nav-campaigns; creator sees grid (5 seeded cards, 3 open + 2 upcoming), no draft/closed leakage; area+category filters work; clear resets; detail page renders title/brief/deliverables/budget; apply → applied badge; persisted across reload; dashboard tile links to /campaigns; nav-campaigns visible for creator/admin only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1044 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, creators.py, campaigns.py, seed.py) before adding more features.
apply_to_campaign duplicate detection relies on 'duplicate key' substring in exception message — fragile. Prefer catching pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError explicitly.
brand_name in _serialize_campaign falls back to user.name if brand_profile missing; ensure profile is always created (currently done at register + upsert in seed, so OK).
GET /campaigns/filters returns distinct across live campaigns only; if a filter is applied and no data matches, dropdown still shows all options (fine, matches spec).
test_credentials: Admin: creators@wearemonk.in / WeAreMonk@2026. Fresh creator/brand users registered per test run.
seed_data_creation: None manually created; startup _seed_demo_campaigns() creates 4 demo brand users + 7 campaigns (5 live, 1 draft, 1 closed) idempotently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests: /app/backend/tests/test_creator_profile.py and /app/backend/tests/test_campaigns.py. Run with `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && export $(grep -v '^#' /app/backend/.env | xargs) && pytest /app/backend/tests -v`. Seed function reads DB and only inserts missing rows, so it is safe to run repeatedly. Draft & closed seeded campaigns are the canonical negative fixtures for status filtering.
